description:
Hello. We’re Alya and Shaikha. We joined the NASA Space Apps Challenge because of our love for space exploration and passion for learning about the world around us.

This challenge allowed us to apply our creativity, coding and design skills, along with our knowledge of space and its fundamentals.

We created an interactive, educational space training program for young aspiring astronomers, engaging them with questions that guide their future in astronomy.
summary: ORBITAL ARCHITECT is a browser-based aerospace engineering and orbital mechanics simulator developed with HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript. The Mission Campaign involves selecting a target (LEO, Moon or Europa), designing a spacecraft with tight budget, mass, power and downlink constraints, coping with four flight anomalies and a graded debrief. In the N-Body Sandbox, players can drag probes, moons, planets or stars to slingshot them, with live trajectory previews and gravity/time controls.
details:
How It Works:

  1. Pick a Mission: Choose Earth, the Moon, or Jupiter—each with different budgets, sunlight levels, and radiation hazards.
  2. Build Your Craft: Select your rocket, body armor, solar or nuclear power, communications dish, and science tools while staying under budget and weight limits.
  3. Launch & Fly: Watch your spacecraft orbit its target and make quick choices during space storms and data downloads.
  4. Report Card: Get a grade (S–D) based on your science points, remaining budget, and ship health.
  5. Orbit Sandbox: Test your spacecraft in a live 2D gravity simulator where you can click and drag to launch new probes, moons, planets, and stars.
